test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.**

Governments must translate their sustainable development goals into national legaslation.
solution: The correct answer is** "legaslation"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**legaslation**" is incorrect in the given sentence. The correct spelling is "**legislation**". • Let's take a look at the meaning of the given options: • **legislation: **laws, considered collectively. • **development: **the process of developing or being developed. • **translate: **express the sense of (words or text) in another language. • **sustainable: **able to be maintained at a certain rate or level. • Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer. **Correct sentence**__: *Governments must translate their sustainable development goals into national __**legislation**__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • legislation: कानून, सामूहिक रूप से माने जाते हैं। • development: विकसित होने की प्रक्रिया। • translate: किसी अन्य भाषा में (शब्दों या पाठ) के अर्थ को व्यक्त करना। • sustainable: एक निश्चित दर या स्तर पर बनाए रखने में सक्षम। a0:T5a7, The correct answer is "**out of**"
